title: International Foundation Diploma In Business Management Level 3
description: Enhance your business acumen and leadership skills with the Endorsed Diploma in Business Management (Level 3).
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core business principles, including accounting, management, and marketing. Students will develop essential skills in decision-making, financial analysis, and organizational behaviour to prepare for various business challenges. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The Endorsed Diploma in Business Management (Level 3) covers critical subjects such as Communication for Business (20 credits), The Business Environment (20 credits), People Management (20 credits), Customer Service (20 credits), Finance in Business (20 credits), and Marketing (20 credits). Graduates will be well-equipped to pursue careers in various sectors or further their studies in business-related fields.
courseDetailParagraphs: The Endorsed Diploma in Business Management (Level 3) covers critical subjects such as Communication for Business (20 credits), The Business Environment (20 credits), People Management (20 credits), Customer Service (20 credits), Finance in Business (20 credits), and Marketing (20 credits). Graduates will be well-equipped to pursue careers in various sectors or further their studies in business-related fields.
entry: International Foundation Diploma In Business Management (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the Endorsed Diploma In Business Management (Level-3) students become eligible to get level 3 award.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.
Complete several modules ranging from Business Leadership and Managing People.
Obtain a degree without necessarily leaving your country.
advantages: Blended delivery is recorded on the official programme page.

modules.title: Level 3 - The Business Environment
modules.summary: This module covers the foundational aspects of the business environment and how external and internal factors influence organizations. The course content is designed to provide students with a detailed understanding of key elements such as economic systems, government policies, social, technological, and environmental factors that shape the business landscape. Practical examples and scenarios will help bridge theory with real-world applications.

lessons.title: Unit 4 -5 Political and Socio Cultural Environment
Unit 6-7 Tecnological Environment and Environmental Factors

modules.title: Level 3 - Communication For Business
modules.summary: This module equips students with the foundational skills required to communicate effectively in a business environment. Emphasis is placed on verbal, non-verbal, and written communication, alongside modern tools and platforms used for professional interactions. The module uses real-world scenarios to foster practical application and enhance problem-solving skills.

lessons.title: Effective Communication Styles and Feedback Adaptation

modules.title: Level 3 - Customer Service
modules.summary: This module is designed to provide students with comprehensive knowledge and practical skills to excel in customer service roles. It covers the key concepts, strategies, and tools needed to provide exceptional customer service in various business settings. By the end of this course, students will be able to apply customer service principles effectively, handle customer complaints, and understand the importance of customer loyalty and satisfaction.

modules.title: Level 3 Finance In Business
modules.summary: Course Overview: This module introduces Level 3 students to the essential concepts of finance in business, including financial planning, budgeting, financial reporting, and analysis. Students will develop the skills needed to interpret financial statements, make informed business decisions, and understand how financial management impacts business performance. Practical examples, real-life case studies, and interactive scenarios are included to provide students with a clear understanding of how finance operates in a business context.

lessons.title: Unit 7-9 Taxation, FRM, and Ethical Consideration

modules.title: Level 3 - Marketing
modules.summary: This module will provide an in-depth understanding of marketing principles and their practical application in the business world. Through a combination of theory and real-world examples, students will gain the knowledge and skills needed to effectively implement marketing strategies, communicate value to customers, and analyze marketing performance.

lessons.title: Introduction to Marketing and Consumer Behaviour
Market Segmentation, Branding, and Digital Marketing

modules.title: Level 3 - People Management
modules.summary: Course Overview: This comprehensive People Management module aims to equip students with the essential skills and knowledge to manage, lead, and develop people within organizations. Students will explore key concepts in leadership, motivation, communication, performance management, team dynamics, and conflict resolution, among others. Practical examples, real-world case studies, and scenarios will be used to reinforce the learning process.

lessons.title: Introductory Theories and Practices of Poeple Management
Performance Measurement, conflict resolution and Diverisity
